[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (9:15–9:18):

**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ’ αὐτῶν, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.

**9:18** ἀπὸ τῶν τριῶν πληγῶν τούτων ἀπεκτάνθησαν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ⸀ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ τοῦ καπνοῦ καὶ τοῦ θείου τοῦ ἐκπορευομένου ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «It's time.». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at the hour that was prepared — ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν — four angels held at a threshold built specifically for this moment, and what breaks loose is not chaos but a schedule: hour and day and month and year, four nested temporal units that collapse into a single releasing instant. The rite opens here, on this axis: what does it mean to be ready for an appointed time, and what does that readiness cost the one who holds it? The verses hold a loosing, a number beyond counting, a vision of mouths that are also weapons, and a third of humanity taken by three things that come from the same source. The rotation will traverse each of these on its own axis — the cost of the appointed hour, the symmetry foreclosed by the killing that only flows one direction, the species-register of horses whose heads are lions and whose mouths are fires, the scale at which one-third becomes a grammar rather than a statistic. What the witness invoked with *It's time* — the casting has arrived at the exact text in which time itself is the mechanism of destruction. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
